exposure: Management strategies for CSEP (intracardiac injection of potassium chloride and methotrexate, ultrasound-guided curettage)
outcome: Successful resolution of cardiac activity and collapse of gestational sac
cohort: Six patients diagnosed with Cesarean scar ectopic pregnancy.
finding: All six patients with CSEP recovered successfully without major surgery following various non-surgical management approaches including intracardiac injection of KCl and methotrexate or ultrasound-guided curettage.
mod_finding: Cesarean scar ectopic pregnancy is associated with previous cesarean deliveries, necessitating a high degree of suspicion for diagnosis.
